title: The machine role
description: GET /v1/next/coordinator: the machine role as the Dashboard reads it. It is a read of the same record GET /v1/orchestrator/coordinator answers (coordination.schema.json); registering and rebinding are only there — this route no longer takes a POST, so the role has one door. A session is its conversation id (`conversationId`); `terminalId` is where it is now (broker-design #36).

Liveness.description: What a current inventory says about the bound process. An incomplete reading answers `unknown`, never `offline`: absence of evidence is not proof of death.

generation.description: Increments on every rebind, so a stale caller holding an old view cannot move a role that has already moved.

terminalId.description: The terminal the bound session is in now. A place, not a session.
